https://www.smartmontools.org/

smartctl is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or (at your option) any
later version (SPDX: GPL-2.0-or-later). The full licence text is third-party/GPL-2.0.txt.

smartctl is distributed as a separate executable program. The application that bundles it
(for example Pulse.app/Contents/Helpers/smartctl) starts it as a child process and exchanges
data over standard output only; it is not linked into the application.

The binary is built, unmodified, from the upstream source tarball
smartmontools-7.5.tar.gz (sha256 690b83ca331378da9ea0d9d61008c4b22dde391387b9bbad7f29387f2595f76e),
with the script native-artifacts/smartmontools/build-macos.sh. No patches are applied.

Windows: Helpers\smartctl.exe in the Pulse install folder is the unmodified x64 smartctl.exe from the
official smartmontools 7.5 Windows installer (smartmontools-7.5.win32-setup.exe, sha256
896337fcc253220614cf8cdbd5cf2321c5aa326a37a04160a672a281e6104c70, from
https://github.com/smartmontools/smartmontools/releases/tag/RELEASE_7_5). Pulse starts it as a child
process only. Its corresponding source is the same smartmontools-7.5.tar.gz, available at that release page
and at https://sourceforge.net/projects/smartmontools/files/smartmontools/7.5/.

Source offer: the corresponding source (that exact tarball, plus the build script and
third-party/BUILD-NOTES-smartctl-macos-arm64.txt) is published next to every binary
distribution at: https://pub-6c73208d46c245a9b4881d5e02f6b618.r2.dev/native-tools/smartmontools-7.5-1/ (smartmontools-7.5.tar.gz, .asc, SHA256SUMS).
You may also obtain it from https://github.com/smartmontools/smartmontools/releases/tag/RELEASE_7_5.
